HIGHEST PRIORITY GEOMETRY CHANGE FROM THE ATTACHED REFERENCE: its face is noticeably diagonal. DO NOT COPY THAT TILT. Recompose Anon's head STRAIGHT UPRIGHT and front-facing, with facial centerline exactly VERTICAL. The centers of BOTH EYES must have exactly the SAME Y POSITION on a perfectly HORIZONTAL eye line. Both cheeks must be at the SAME height. Only the brows and smile may be asymmetric. The head cannot lean toward a paw. The body may curve slightly while hanging, but the facial plane remains upright. This is essential for a readable upright UI face.

Create ONE new original transparent-background vertical edge companion sprite of Chihaya Anon from MyGO!!!!!, using a simple 2D human-cartoon head integrated with a complete white meme-cat body. The attached accepted Sakiko pilot is ONLY a reference for family drawing simplicity and the relation of a hanging vertical body to clasping paws. It is NOT a face, hair, color, expression or character reference for Anon. Redesign her from the identity and moment below. Never swap hair color on Sakiko's existing head.

Anon: recognisable LONG pink hair, light grouped fringe with a slightly diagonal rhythm, broad soft side locks that extend past the shoulders in a few readable shapes, clear gray-blue irises. No Sakiko ribbons, no large invented hair accessory, no heterochromia. A young lively face reduced to the family's flat WHITE face, simple round TWO-FLAT-ZONE gray-blue eyes and clean dark navy outlines. Few hair blocks, no strand-by-strand rendering or gloss. Head, white torso, paws and tail all share the SAME sparse flat 2D drawing language. No human costume, collar, uniform or socks. No realistic fur, flesh color, plush toy, 3D volume, mature makeup, infant glass eyes, or detailed human head pasted onto an animal.

This instant is specifically hers: she has been trying to straighten a slightly crooked corner at the edge of their paper construction and was rather pleased with herself. The familiar person notices that she has made it crooked the other way. She pauses halfway through the adjustment, looks out toward them and owns the joke, still a little reluctant to concede. Her gray-blue eyes are alert and directed level toward the viewer; ONE brow lifts slightly, the other remains more level. A tiny CLOSED asymmetric smile, just one corner up, carries amused embarrassment rather than a perfect gentle grin. Do not use an open surprise mouth, wink, tears, sweatdrop, heart or emoji. Her lower paw remains settled against the imagined edge as if she might finish her own small adjustment once the moment passes. There is no need to draw the paper or props.

Critical geometry: do not rotate a horizontal loaf cat. Draw an actually VERTICAL complete white cat torso below the head, a bent connected hind leg, and full tail. Her FACE is upright, front-facing, facial midline vertical; centers of BOTH EYES at the exact same height, horizontal, unlike the diagonal head in the reference. Asymmetrical brows do not tilt the whole facial plane. Body on the LEFT of an imaginary vertical edge, paws reaching to the RIGHT. Two front paws curl round that same unseen edge, one near the lower cheek and one at upper belly height. Their contact tips should align near one vertical x coordinate, around 82 percent of the canvas width. The bent hind paw lower down also braces that side. Shoulders, arms, rump, hind leg and tail root must connect naturally; no loose limbs or spare paws. The white tail descends from the rump and makes a relaxed single down-left curve, not a detached shape. Long pink hair should sweep down the outer LEFT shoulder and behind the body, never cover the paw-contact contour. A pair of minimal cat ears can sit behind the hair; they are anatomy for this original cat form, not official human accessories.

Portrait composition, entire head/ears/long hair/body/paws/tail uncut, generous transparent margins. Match the approved family head-to-body weight and concise outline, but do not trace its pose exactly. Flat warm-white face/body fill, restrained pink hair with at most two flat zones, gray-blue two-zone irises. Dark navy contour with clear hand-drawn softness. Absolutely NO outer glow, colored halo, cast shadow, translucent cloud, background, floor, visible ledge, panel, vertical line, ruler or rectangle. Only normal narrow antialiasing immediately outside the outline; otherwise genuine transparent RGBA. No text, speech bubble, UI, border or watermark. This must be a newly drawn individual vertical sprite, not a screenshot, cropped avatar or collage.
